description: This file defines the configuration class for the SystemCheck plugin in the OrangeHRM system. It implements plugin and console configuration interfaces, providing methods to initialize the plugin and register console commands, specifically the ToggleSystemCheckScreenCommand.

classes.name: SystemCheckPluginConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration class for SystemCheck plugin, responsible for initializing the plugin and registering console commands.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the current request. Currently an empty implementation.

methods.name: registerCommands
methods.description: Registers the ToggleSystemCheckScreenCommand to the console.
